vc.saveError: 變聲參數／降噪儲存失敗；目前設定仍可用，重開後可能遺失。
Could not save VC parameters / noise reduction; current settings still work but may be lost after restart.
parameters.invalid.rvc: Crossfade must not exceed block size.
parameters.invalid.seed: 交疊不得超過區塊；內容編碼上下文不得小於 DiT 上下文。
Crossfade must not exceed the block; encoder context must not be shorter than DiT context.
parameters.invalid.xvc: Current 必須大於 0；Current／Chunk／Future 須為 80 ms 倍數；Smooth 不得大於 Current，三者總和不得超過 Chunk。
Current must be positive; Current / Chunk / Future must be multiples of 80 ms; Smooth must not exceed Current and their sum must fit Chunk.

Help: {label}
noise.title: 輸入降噪（變聲前）
Input noise reduction (before conversion)
effects.apply: 自動儲存 · 變聲下次開始套用；TTS 下次送出套用。
Saved automatically · VC applies on next Start; TTS applies on next submission.
load.title: 預估模型載入
Estimated model loading
load.last: 上次階段進度 {seconds} 秒前
load.measured: 本次模型載入／預熱 {seconds} 秒
load.slow: 載入較久，尚未判定失敗；可停止或查看診斷資料。
Loading is taking longer; no failure confirmed. You can stop or inspect diagnostics.
help.load: 這是此電腦歷史量測的模型載入／預熱範圍，不是等待上限，也不包含所有環境準備、TTS 生成或播放時間。少量樣本可能波動。程序存活只表示尚未退出，不保證模型持續前進；超過估計可查看診斷或停止。切換／重開需冷載入；TTS 同引擎次句通常重用。

Historical model load / warmup measurements on this PC, not a timeout or total wait. Environment preparation, TTS generation and playback are separate. Small samples vary. An alive process is not proof of progress. Inspect diagnostics or stop if needed. Restarting or switching loads again; same-engine TTS requests usually reuse the model.
help.effects: 每個引擎獨立保存音效，切換後還原。音效在模型轉換／生成後處理，主輸出和監聽使用相同結果。關閉音效會略過 EQ、壓縮、殘響和增益，但不關閉獨立的輸入降噪。數值離開欄位後保存；VC 下次開始、TTS 下次送出套用，已排隊句子保持原設定。

Each engine stores separate effects. Effects run after conversion / generation; output and monitoring receive the same result. Disabling effects bypasses EQ, compression, reverb and gain, but not independent input noise reduction. Numbers save on blur. VC applies on next Start, TTS on next submission; queued requests keep their original settings.
help.noise: 先降低來源音訊的風扇、冷氣和嘶聲，再交給變聲模型。四個 VC 共用，RVC WAV 來源也支援；TTS 不使用。最大抑制量越高，底噪越弱，但氣音和字尾也可能受損。從 12 dB 小幅調整，若水聲或顫抖增加就降低。算法增加 20 ms 延遲；下次開始套用，不能修復模型生成的電子感。

Reduces steady fan, air-conditioning and hiss in source audio before VC. Shared by four VC engines, including RVC WAV mode; not TTS. Higher attenuation can damage breaths and word endings. Start at 12 dB and increase gradually; reduce it if watery or trembling artifacts appear. Adds 20 ms algorithmic delay. Applies on next Start; does not repair model-generated robotic artifacts.
help.noise.strength: 限制最多壓低多少 dB，0 為完全 bypass；不是音量增益或靜音門。建議 6～12 dB 起步，需要時逐步提高到 18 dB。過強可能產生水聲或削弱細節；下次開始套用。

Caps suppression in dB; 0 is exact bypass. This is not output gain or a hard noise gate. Try 6–12 dB first, then gradually increase toward 18 dB if needed. Excessive suppression can sound watery or remove detail. Applies on next Start.
help.fx.wet: 0 是變聲／TTS 完成後的乾聲，1 是完全套用 EQ、壓縮與殘響的聲音；不混入原始麥克風。提高可加強音效，降低可保留自然細節。輸出增益在混合後套用，輸入降噪另行控制。下次開始／送出套用。

0 is dry converted / generated audio; 1 is fully EQ/compression/reverb processed audio. Original microphone audio is not mixed in. Increase for stronger effects, lower to preserve detail. Output gain follows blending; input noise reduction is independent. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.fx.output_gain_db: 調整最後輸出音量；正值變大聲、負值降低。它不會去除噪音，也不改音高。峰值接近 1 或聲音破裂時先降低；提升可能觸及限幅而失真。下次開始／送出套用。

Final output volume: positive boosts, negative reduces. Does not remove noise or change pitch. Lower it if peaks approach 1 or audio clips. Boosting can hit the limiter and distort. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.fx.low_db: 約 250 Hz 以下的厚度與低沉感。提高讓聲音厚一些，但可能混濁；降低可減少轟聲和低頻底噪。先以 1～2 dB 比較；不能代替音高調整或降噪。下次開始／送出套用。

Controls body below roughly 250 Hz. Boost for warmth, but too much sounds muddy; cut to reduce rumble. Compare in 1–2 dB steps. Not a replacement for pitch control or noise reduction. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.fx.mid_db: 低頻與高頻之間的語音主体、清晰度。提高可能更清楚也更鼻音；降低可減少箱音，但太多會變薄。先小幅 ±1～2 dB 比較。下次開始／送出套用。

Controls the voice body between low and high bands. Boost may improve clarity or increase nasal tone; cut can reduce boxiness but make speech thin. Compare in ±1–2 dB steps. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.fx.high_db: 約 4 kHz 以上的明亮度、齒音與氣音。降低可柔化刺耳與嘶聲，提高增加細節但也放大高頻噪音。聲音偏高可先試 -1～-3 dB 柔化，但這不會降低音高。下次開始／送出套用。

Brightness, sibilance and breath above roughly 4 kHz. Cut to soften harshness or hiss; boost adds detail and high-frequency noise. Try -1 to -3 dB for a softer sound, but this does not lower pitch. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.fx.compressor_threshold_db: 超過此音量才壓縮。更負的值讓更多聲音被壓低；較接近 0 只壓較大聲部分。可穩定音量，過低會削弱起伏；它不會降噪。下次開始／送出套用。

Compression starts above this level. More negative values compress more of the voice; closer to 0 affects louder parts only. Helps even volume, but a low threshold can flatten dynamics. Not noise reduction. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.fx.compressor_ratio: 超過閾值後的壓縮程度，1 是不壓縮；2～3 適合輕度穩定音量。更高可能讓聲音扁平、抽動。若顫抖先試 1 並關閉殘響比較。下次開始／送出套用。

Compression above the threshold: 1 disables compression; 2–3 is gentle leveling. Higher ratios can flatten or pump the voice. For trembling, try 1 and disable reverb to compare. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.fx.reverb_mix: 加入空間與尾音，0 為無殘響。提高會更有空間感，但也可能模糊字尾或讓接縫更明顯。通話建議先用 0～0.05；排查斷音先設 0。下次開始／送出套用。
Adds space and echo tails; 0 means none. More can blur endings or expose seams. Try 0–0.05 for calls, and 0 while investigating gaps. Applies on next Start / submission.
help.host: Windows 音訊驅動介面；輸入和主輸出必須選同一介面下的精確裝置。先沿用可穩定使用的 DirectSound 或 WASAPI，切換後重新確認裝置；不能只靠介面名稱推論延遲。停止後修改，下次開始套用。

Windows audio driver interface. Input and primary output must be exact devices under the same host API. Keep a stable DirectSound or WASAPI route, and reselect devices after changing it. The API name alone does not establish latency. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.input: 選擇真正收音的麥克風。輸入峰值一直為零時檢查靜音、權限和裝置。不要把同條 CABLE 的 Output 回送到 Input，避免回授。停止後修改，下次開始套用。

Select the microphone that captures your voice. If input peak stays zero, check mute, permissions and device selection. Never feed a CABLE Output back to its matching Input. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.output: 耳機／喇叭可直接聽到；CABLE Input 將聲音送到虛擬線路，接收端要選 CABLE Output。輸出到虚擬線路時可另開自己監聽到實體耳機。停止後修改，下次開始套用。

Headphones / speakers are audible directly. CABLE Input sends to a virtual cable; the receiving app selects CABLE Output. Enable separate physical-headphone monitoring when using a virtual output. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.monitor: 把處理後的聲音另送到實體耳機／喇叭，方便自己聽。不能選虛擬線路作監聽；同一實體主輸出會避免重複播放。建議用耳機以減少回授。停止後修改，下次開始套用。

Sends processed audio to physical headphones / speakers so you can hear it. Virtual routes cannot be monitor targets; duplicate playback to the same physical output is avoided. Prefer headphones to limit feedback. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.reference: Seed／Mean／X 用這段 WAV 的聲線作參考，不是要轉換的來源。清楚、少噪音且單一說話者的參考音較適合。換參考後需重新開始並載入 conditioning；RVC 則使用角色模型。

Seed / Mean / X use this WAV as the target voice, not the source to convert. Prefer clean audio from one speaker. Changing it requires restarting and rebuilding conditioning; RVC uses a trained character model instead.
help.symptom.gaps: 先關閉音效、殘響和降噪比較。查看 RTF 是否持續 >1，以及丟棄／輸出不足是否增加。Seed 可先降低推論步數；RVC／Seed 可適量加大區塊（延遲也增加），再調交疊。X 檢查 Current／Future／Smooth 的視窗限制。每次只改一項，停止後重啟比較。

Compare with effects, reverb and noise reduction disabled. Check for sustained RTF >1 or increasing drops / underruns. Reduce Seed diffusion steps; moderately increase RVC / Seed block size at the cost of latency, then tune crossfade. Check X window constraints. Change one setting at a time and restart.
help.symptom.tremble: 先比對音效 bypass；壓縮比試 1、殘響試 0。降噪太強也會削弱氣音，先降低強度。RVC 用同一模型比較 FCPE／RMVPE，並檢查音高是否過度偏移。EQ 不會修復音高擷取不穩。

Compare effects bypass; try compression ratio 1 and reverb 0. Strong noise suppression can damage breaths, so reduce it. Compare FCPE / RMVPE on the same RVC model and avoid extreme pitch shifts. EQ cannot repair unstable pitch tracking.
help.symptom.robot: 先排除丟棄和接縫，再檢查參考音是否乾淨、模型是否適合你的音域。RVC 可把 Index 從 0.75 逐步試 0.5、0.25；每次重啟比較。高頻小幅削減只能柔化刺耳，降噪不保證消除模型生成的電子感。

Rule out drops and seams, then check reference quality and model suitability for your vocal range. For RVC compare Index 0.75, 0.5 and 0.25, restarting each time. A small high-frequency cut softens harshness; noise reduction does not guarantee removal of model-generated artifacts.
help.symptom.pitch: RVC 先試音高 -1～-2 半音，再用同一段說話比較。高頻 EQ -1～-3 dB 可降低明亮感，但不是降音高。其他已整合的 VC 不提供原生半音控制；可換較低聲線的參考音或模型。

For RVC try -1 to -2 semitones and compare the same phrase. High EQ -1 to -3 dB reduces brightness, not pitch. The other integrated VC models do not provide native semitone controls; try a lower target reference or model.
help.symptom.noise: 啟用變聲前降噪，從 6～12 dB 開始小幅增加，留意氣音與字尾。啟動前先保持短暫安靜有利底噪估計。低頻轟聲可小幅降低低頻 EQ，嘶聲可降低高頻 EQ；壓縮與輸出增益不會去噪。

Enable pre-conversion noise reduction; start at 6–12 dB and increase gradually while checking breaths and endings. Brief silence after starting helps estimate background noise. A small low EQ cut helps rumble, high EQ cut helps hiss. Compression and gain do not remove noise.
help.rvc.model_id: 使用登錄的角色模型／Index，不是 zero-shot 參考音。切換角色會重載。停止後修改，下次開始套用。
Uses a registered character checkpoint / index, not a zero-shot reference. Changing character reloads it. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.rvc.source_mode: 麥克風模式持續轉換收音；WAV 模式轉換並播放來源檔。兩者都能使用輸入降噪。停止後修改，下次開始套用。
Microphone mode converts live capture; WAV mode converts and plays a source file. Both support input noise reduction. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.rvc.f0_method: FCPE／RMVPE 擷取來源音高；顫抖時可用同一模型比較兩者。音色品質及耗時依聲音與模型而異。停止後修改，下次開始重新載入／預熱。
FCPE / RMVPE track source pitch. Compare both on the same model for trembling. Quality and processing cost depend on voice and model. Change while stopped; next Start reloads / warms up.
help.rvc.pitch: 以半音移動來源音高；負值降低、正值提高，0 不偏移。先試 ±1～2，極端值可能不自然。停止後修改，下次開始套用。
Shifts source pitch in semitones: negative lowers, positive raises, 0 keeps it. Try ±1–2 first; extreme values can sound unnatural. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.rvc.index_rate: 檢索角色特徵的混合比例。提高可能更像模型，但也可能增加不自然；電子感可逐步試 0.5、0.25。0 略過 Index blend。停止後修改，下次開始套用。
Amount of retrieved character features. Higher may improve likeness but also artifacts; compare 0.5 or 0.25 for robotic sound. 0 bypasses index blending. Change while stopped; applies on next Start.
help.rvc.chunk: 每次處理的來源區塊。提高通常增加延遲但減少每秒呼叫次數；降低反應較快但較容易跟不上。先看 RTF／丟棄再調；交疊不得大於區塊。下次開始套用。

Source block size. Larger usually increases latency but reduces calls per second; smaller responds faster but may fall behind. Check RTF / drops first. Crossfade must not exceed block size. Applies on next Start.
help.rvc.crossfade: 相鄰區塊交疊，用來柔化接縫；目前核心最多使用 40 ms 的 SOLA 交疊。提高設定超過 40 ms 不代表更多平滑，仍不得大於區塊。下次開始套用。

Overlap between blocks to soften seams. The current core caps actual SOLA overlap at 40 ms; increasing the setting beyond 40 ms does not add smoothing. Must not exceed block size. Applies on next Start.
help.rvc.extra_time: 保留較早的來源音訊給模型。更多上下文可能更穩定，也增加運算與記憶體；不是純輸出延遲數字。先沿用 1 秒，再小幅比較。下次開始套用。

Past source audio retained for inference. More context may improve stability but increases computation / memory; it is not an output-latency figure. Start from 1 second and compare gradually. Applies on next Start.
help.meanvc2.model: 40ms／120ms 是不同上下文配置的模型，並非端到端延遲保證。120ms 提供更多模型上下文但可能增加延遲；換模型會重載。下次開始套用。
40ms / 120ms are models with different context configurations, not end-to-end latency guarantees. 120ms provides more model context and may add latency. Changing the model reloads it on next Start.
help.seed-vc.diffusion_steps: 更多步數可能改善細節，但增加處理時間。RTF >1 或斷音時先降低，例如 10→8→6；少步數也可能增加電子感。下次開始套用。
More steps may improve detail but increase computation. For RTF >1 or gaps try 10→8→6. Too few steps may sound more robotic. Applies on next Start.
help.seed-vc.inference_cfg_rate: 控制推論引導強度；不等於音高或降噪。提高可能更強烈遵循條件，也可能失真；先沿用 0.7，再小幅比較。下次開始套用。
Inference guidance strength, not pitch or denoising. Higher may follow conditioning more strongly but add artifacts. Start from 0.7 and compare small changes. Applies on next Start.
help.seed-vc.max_prompt_length: 限制使用參考聲音的秒數。更長提供更多聲線資料，但增加準備／運算成本；參考音太吵時增加長度未必有益。下次開始套用。
Limits target reference duration. Longer references provide more voice information but add preparation / processing cost; noisy references may not benefit. Applies on next Start.
help.seed-vc.block_time: 每次處理的來源秒數；增加可減少呼叫次數，但增加等待。降低較即時，也可能跟不上。先看 RTF，比較 0.3→0.4；交疊不得超過區塊。下次開始套用。

Seconds of source per inference. Larger reduces calls but increases waiting; smaller responds faster but may fall behind. Check RTF and compare 0.3→0.4. Crossfade must not exceed the block. Applies on next Start.
help.seed-vc.crossfade_length: 用交疊和 SOLA 柔化接縫，不得超過區塊。核心实际 SOLA 交疊上限 40 ms，超過不保證更平滑。先沿用 0.04 秒；下次開始套用。

Overlap / SOLA softens seams and must not exceed block size. Actual SOLA overlap is capped at 40 ms, so larger settings do not guarantee smoother seams. Start from 0.04 seconds. Applies on next Start.
help.seed-vc.extra_time_ce: 內容編碼器保留的歷史上下文，不得小於 DiT 歷史上下文。提高會增加工作量／記憶體，需觀察 RTF。下次開始套用。
Past context for the content encoder; must not be shorter than DiT past context. Increasing adds work / memory; watch RTF. Applies on next Start.
help.seed-vc.extra_time: DiT 使用的歷史上下文，不得大於內容編碼上下文。增加可能改善連續性，也增加運算。先沿用 0.5 秒，再小幅比較。下次開始套用。
Past context used by DiT; must not exceed content encoder context. More may improve continuity but adds computation. Start from 0.5 seconds and compare gradually. Applies on next Start.
help.seed-vc.extra_time_right: 保留右側／未來來源音訊供模型推論；增加會增加等待與運算，不是音高控制。即時使用先沿用 0.02 秒。下次開始套用。
Future source context for inference. More adds waiting / computation, not pitch control. Start from 0.02 seconds for live use. Applies on next Start.
help.xvc.current: 每次輸出的目前區塊，麥克風模式必須大於 0，且須符合 codec 的 80 ms 對齊。提高通常增加等待，降低增加呼叫頻率。下次開始套用。
Current block emitted per inference. Must be positive for microphone mode and aligned to the codec's 80 ms grid. Larger adds waiting; smaller increases call frequency. Applies on next Start.
help.xvc.chunk: 包含歷史、目前、未來和平滑的總視窗；必須容納 Current + Future + Smooth，並以 80 ms 對齊。增加需要更多記憶體／運算。下次開始套用。
Total history/current/future/smoothing window. Must fit Current + Future + Smooth and align to 80 ms. Larger adds computation / memory. Applies on next Start.
help.xvc.future: 使用真正未來音訊，不是填零。增加可給更多上下文但增加等待；以 80 ms 對齊，總和不得超過處理視窗。下次開始套用。
Uses actual future audio, not zeros. More provides context but adds waiting; align to 80 ms and fit within the total window. Applies on next Start.
help.xvc.smooth: 區塊接縫的平滑交疊，不得大於 Current。更多可能柔化接縫也可能模糊瞬態；先沿用 20 ms。下次開始套用。
Overlap to smooth block seams; must not exceed Current. More may soften seams or smear transients. Start from 20 ms. Applies on next Start.

P95 is processing time recorded by the engine; included pre/post-processing varies by engine. It is not end-to-end latency. Blocks {blocks} · Input drops {inputDrops} · Output drops {outputDrops} · Underruns {underruns}

WAV mode · Start converts and plays the file without reading the microphone.

Output goes to a virtual cable. Enable self-monitoring to hear it in headphones.
轉換後聲音會同時送到主輸出與監聽裝置。: 轉換後聲音會同時送到主輸出與監聽裝置。
Converted audio goes to both the main output and the monitor device.
